answer: Age-ramped payouts: a fresh key earns only 10% of its graded reward in its first epoch, rising 10 points per epoch to full share at epoch 10, and any missed epoch resets the ramp. A key's quality signal must stay lit like a beacon before it pays in full. A farm of 100 throwaway keys forgoes 0.9+0.8+...+0.1 = 4.5 epochs of reward per key, 450 rewards total, while still writing a passing original answer per key every epoch. Trust accrues like saffron: a few threads per harvest.
